labnotes.title: Temporal synthetic spatial-perception calibration
labnotes.question: Do short grayscale frame sequences plus ego-motion improve local spatial estimates over a matched single-frame baseline on held-out procedural geometry?

relations.rationale: Moves from compact behavioral state interpretation to a separately bounded test of compact machine-facing spatial state.

labnotes.title: Grounded build-time labnote summarization
labnotes.question: Can a versioned AI apparatus produce concise labnote orientations that preserve findings, limitations, and negative results without introducing unsupported claims?

labnotes.title: Readiness-gated bounded-span repair
labnotes.question: Can suffix-triggered readiness plus bounded-span repair recover the deferred-composition idea without freezing incorrect surrounding structure?

relations.rationale: Tests whether explicit readiness and whole-span repair address the structural failure observed in forced single-hole infill.

labnotes.title: Forced deferred-hole composition pilot
labnotes.question: Does deferring one locally uncertain span until right-hand context exists improve bounded composition over direct generation or unrestricted two-pass revision?

relations.rationale: Continues the search for useful inference-time composition structure after extended thinking failed to justify its cost.

labnotes.title: conversation-conditioned two-speaker pilot
labnotes.question: Can conversation-aware turn direction produce a convincing two-speaker exchange where isolated line direction does not?

relations.rationale: Reuses its validated Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice synthesis path while moving evaluation from isolated utterances to a complete two-speaker scene.

labnotes.title: Matched deep-thinking composition campaign
labnotes.question: Does enabling extended model thinking improve bounded composition enough to justify its latency and generation overhead?

relations.rationale: Reuses its twelve public rewrite tasks to isolate reasoning mode from corpus and model changes.

labnotes.title: multi-utterance prosody candidate pool
labnotes.question: Can a small multi-utterance candidate pool supply natural repeated readings for a held-out fingerprint-retrieval test?

relations.rationale: Expands the positive eight-clip representation pilot across unseen lexical content before freezing retrieval.

labnotes.title: acoustic fingerprint pilot
labnotes.question: Do lightweight acoustic fingerprints recover perceived emphasis and expressive delivery in the Prosody 015 corpus?

relations.rationale: Measures whether deterministic acoustic descriptors recover the owner-labeled readings discovered in that corpus.

labnotes.title: emergent prosody annotation
labnotes.question: What coherent readings actually emerge when direct lexical-focus control fails?

relations.rationale: Reframes its natural but misdirected outputs as specimens to characterize rather than failed commands to discard.

labnotes.title: contrastive-focus instruction-form ablation
labnotes.question: Does removing the competing focus word from Qwen's instruction restore directional contrastive emphasis?

relations.rationale: Tests whether the failed paired instruction made the explicitly prohibited competitor salient.

labnotes.title: instruction-conditioned contrastive focus
labnotes.question: Can reference-free natural-language instructions produce natural, directionally correct contrastive focus?

relations.rationale: Replaces failed recorded-reference conditioning with reference-free natural-language prosody instructions.

labnotes.title: reference-conditioned contrastive-focus transfer
labnotes.question: Can whole-utterance reference conditioning reproduce an explicitly demonstrated contrastive focus without the artifacts of post-hoc DSP?

relations.rationale: Retains artifact-free whole-utterance generation while replacing unreliable lexical-stress mapping with an explicit spoken reference.
Prosody 010 showed that native primary-versus-secondary stress did not reliably create directional discourse prominence.

labnotes.title: Semantic namespace token ablation
labnotes.question: Can a semantic namespace token replace the full field dictionary when a local model interprets compact behavioral state?

relations.rationale: Labnote 004 found that the shared field dictionary dominated compact prompt cost, so this note tested whether one semantic namespace could replace it.

labnotes.title: Machine-native state serialization baseline
labnotes.question: Can two-minute behavior windows be represented compactly without loss, and does one local model preserve task recognition across prose, JSON, and typed tokens?

relations.rationale: The feature-family ablation made the surviving behavior fields concrete enough to test compact machine-native serialization.

labnotes.title: Current-task feature-family ablation
labnotes.question: Which observable behavior families carry the 120-second held-seed task-inference signal?

relations.rationale: Removes behavior feature families from the successful held-seed classifier to locate which observations carry its task signal.

labnotes.title: Blinded current-task inference
labnotes.question: Can the current Minecraft task be inferred from causal behavior while holding out an entire seed block?

relations.rationale: Turns the behavioral-vector pilot into a held-seed test of whether causal play behavior identifies the current task.

labnotes.title: Minecraft behavioral-vector pilot
labnotes.question: Can repeated, task-balanced Minecraft sessions produce an interpretable behavioral vector whose within-condition variation is smaller than its uncertainty?

labnotes.title: Fingerprint compiler and blinded scorer calibration
labnotes.question: Which pilot steering coordinates are stable across story states, and can a blinded local model scorer reproduce the human measurements well enough to reduce future review burden?

relations.rationale: Recorded as the preceding labnote in the original lineage metadata.
